note: Adapted from the species-level description in Ahmad's Termites of Thailand (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History, volume 131), originally in English. The original description is headed Soldier (fig. 83) and covers only the soldier caste; the worker appears only in synonymy citations and distribution records, and this volume gives no worker morphology. The range separators in the original are inconsistent (hyphens and dashes mixed) and have been standardised to —. The same volume continues with species of Bulbitermes (prabhae, makhamensis, parapusillus), which do not belong to this species and were not used.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-orange; nasus pale reddish brown; thoracic nota yellowish brown; abdominal tergites light brown; legs pale. The head bears a few scattered setae; the tip of the nasus has 4 short hairs and 2 more setae slightly behind; the anterior margin of the pronotum is bordered by a row of minute hairs, with a few more minute hairs elsewhere; the abdominal tergites have a few minute hairs and 2—3 setae on the posterior margin; the sternites bear short hairs and long setae. Head capsule nearly circular, not constricted behind the antennae; dorsal outline straight; frontal protuberance visible; nasus short, conical, its basal thickness varying within and between colonies. Mandibles lacking the apical part. Antennae 12—13-segmented; in specimens with 13 segments, segment 3 is slightly longer than segment 2 and nearly twice as long as segment 4. Pronotum saddle-shaped; the middle of the anterior margin without a notch; posterior margin convex, not concave. Measurements (13 soldiers, means in parentheses): head length with nasus 1.19—1.35 mm (1.26), head length without nasus 0.75—0.91 mm (0.83), head width 0.75—0.85 mm (0.79), head height 0.46—0.57 mm (0.53), pronotal length 0.18 mm (0.18), pronotal width 0.39—0.44 mm (0.42).
